reviews.x: I'm really frustrated with how difficult it is to use the credit toward a product.  It should be easy to click on what you want, from a list only showing the products that qualify for the credit.

Samples are very tiny, but some are good for carrying in your purse or a one time travel pack.  Great thing is I'm a flosser so I was able to replenish my supply using my credit.  But honestly, it's not worth the price for this box.  I did try the pet food sampler for my dog and that was well worth the price, even though at the moment that sample has flaws too...but that's my other review.
I absolutely love this box. It has so many items to try so you dont waste money buying a full size item not liking it. My favorite so far

reviews.t: You're getting the box for FREE 99, helloooo!
reviews.x: I'm not sure why people are complaining about what they got in their box, considering the way the sample boxes were even structured was so that it didn't essentially cost you anything. Granted, of course, you spent $10 on something in that category (which is BROAD). The I was surprised at how many items were in the box, for sure; however, I wish they were bigger sample sizes. I don't think you could adequately sample the products for long enough to make an informed decision. This is VERY MUCH ap

Compared to other boxes I've had, these sample seemed small. However, I LOVED the Burt's Bees wipes that I found inside and use them regularly now. I had no issue ordering more wipes with my 10 dollar credit. I've read here, where some people didn't receive their emails with credit listed. No worries! I added wipes to my cart and credit instantly appeared! Again,I liked the box but only rate it 4 stars for the smaller sized samples. They're always small just these were really really small sized,

It's a nice sampler, especially if you were planning on buying one of the full sized items. The samples were decently sized and of a good variety. Just be sure you use your credit before it expires!  I took off a star because some of the items, like the white strips, didn't actually include enough for me to get an idea of if they would work. The in shower face mask is incredible and I got many uses out of it.

The sample products are fine, for the most part.  However, I was very limited when ordering to use my equal-to-the-cost voucher.  I wanted the  Roc facial product, 20.99, but noticed an equal sized night cream for 17.99.  The voucher would not work on the lower priced night cream but worked just fine on the higher cost face, chest and neck cream.  Amazon is certainly making its profit.....

reviews.t: Good concept, not sure it's worth $10.
reviews.x: My boyfriend randomly surprised me with this - never knew it even existed. Great concept! However, the item I was most excited to try (Olay) was completely empty. Cut it open to realize there was nothing in there. I'm not sure it's worth $10, because there are some samples in there I may never use. Wish you could customize your own sample box.

reviews.t: Worth it for the 1/2  sale price
reviews.x: I got exactly what was pictured and described for this box. I am very happy for this small purchase of prime samples that I could use that was on sale.I do believe it was worth the money, but if it is not on sale , and it is at the 9.99 original price, I would not recommend it because un my opinion,  that would be too high.

My pre teen daughter wanted this sampler box. She loved being able to try new items and then use the credit to purchase a full sized face wash that she was going to make me buy anyway. She gave me the couple of samples that were clearly for grown ups and she had a great time sampling the rest!

The samples arrived on time. Everything is new and I cant wait to try it all. The vera Wang perfume smells amazing. The rose water has to be my favorite item. I would definitely buy another sample box as long as I could try different items just to mix it up. Overall extremely happy.

reviews.t: Great samples and equal value in products
reviews.x: This beauty box has some great samples and the bonus is you get the value in beauty products.  The Fekkai products alone are almost half the price of the box.  If you use even one or two of these products, then the box is completely worth it.  I definitely plan to buy this again.

There are 10 sample sizes of products for you to try.  They were delivered  in a handy small amazon box.  They are good for testing the products not all at once.  They are made from different companies so I might have to try each at a time to see how they work.

Total waste of money. I buy a whole lot of stuff I probably don’t need, but none of them will be full-sized items out of this box. Very disappointed in these samples and the $10+ I spent on them. Honestly, you shouldn't have to pay for samples, anyway.

I had a damaged product and there was glass all over the box, amazon customer service didn't help too much. But all of the samples are, well, sample sized. And I don't think that I'll really ever use that credit that we receive for buying

I liked the Aveeno lotion. The DOC product was very tiny and had more air than product. Otherwise, I cannot comment as the advertised possible samples were not to be found. Am becoming more and more disillusioned with Amazon.

I wanted to try some of these products for some time now and these samples gave me that opportunity; liked them most of them...except the Burt Bees wipes they irritated the eyes( but had a great grapefruit smell) :)

It’s okay. I wasn’t expecting such small samples. Some are not big enough for a single use. But, full of Aveeno products that I love. Some brands I’ve never heard of so hesitant in using around eye areas.

reviews.t: Tried a few new (to me) products
reviews.x: What a great way to try different products! Everything in the box is useful to me. I really liked the Burt's Bees towelettes and the PCA collagen hydrator. Very happy with what I received in this box.

reviews.t: One of the items in the package foze and exploded, ruining everything in the box.
reviews.x: There was a liquid that froze and exploded in the box, saturating everything as it defrosted. The items were ruined and the scent was very overwhelming. Don't waste your time on this box.
I love sample boxes! Yes, these are small samples but if you have sensitive skin (Luke me), then sampling is a must! Great way to save money and make sure you love it, before you buy!
I love my sample box! It comes with a good selection of products to try and it is basically free because you get reimbursed with a credit you can put towards a full sized product.

reviews.t: Was great but bonus for ordering never worked
reviews.x: This was my favorite!!! But when I went to use the credit I was supposed to get, it wouldn't work, and you can't order this anymore!!! I'm very sad, it had the best products ever.
Great amount of products for the price.  A lot of sample sizes but the value on some of the products is insane.  Loved trying so many things that I wouldn’t consider normally.
This is a great box to start out with if you’re interested in trying products. I do wish there were a variety of boxes but it seems that the samples are always the same

claims.text: Many reviewers find the box a good value, especially when on sale or when the credit is used toward a full-size purchase.
Several reviewers say the samples are very small or tiny.
Some reviewers report difficulty using the credit or limitations on which products it applies to.
A few reviewers were disappointed, citing empty or damaged samples and feeling it wasn't worth the money.
Reviewers enjoy trying a variety of new products and would buy again.
